name: Grid Worm
description: Full-size canvas background where colorful worms crawl along an invisible grid, turning at random junctions and leaving glowing trails with arrow heads.
contents: Canvas filled with animated worms on a grid
behavior: Worms move along grid lines and pick a new direction at junctions
Each worm keeps a short trail of recent junctions
Clicking the canvas respawns all worms
Canvas resizes with its container and worms respawn
editableByProps: Background color, worm count, speed, trail length and grid spacing
Grid dot visibility and color, worm size
fixed: Worm colors come from a fixed palette picked at random
arrowOpacity and lineWidth are accepted but not used by the drawing code
Root is at least the viewport height and the canvas fills it
